full_name: Spanish Low Vision Quality of Life Questionnaire (Spanish version of the LVQOL, Wolffsohn and Cochrane)
domains: Far vision, mobility and lighting; Adaptation; Reading and precision work; Activities of daily life
response_scale: 0-5 (0 = can no longer perform activity due to vision; 5 = no difficulty); N/A allowed
scoring: sum of item scores, range 0-125 (N/A given average score); lower = lower quality of life
validation_method: CTT; internal consistency; test-retest; criterion validity; ROC; IRT; factor analysis
notes: time reported in seconds only (393.5 s telephone VI, 290.0 s face-to-face VI; p5-6); Cronbach alpha 0.981 (p5)

full_name: National Eye Institute Visual Function Questionnaire 25
domains: 13 dimensions: General health, General vision, Ocular pain, Near vision, Distance vision, Vision-specific social functioning, Vision-specific mental health, Expectations for visual function, Vision-specific role functioning, Dependency due to vision, Driving, Peripheral vision, Color vision
scoring: 0 (worst) to 100 (best) per dimension plus overall score
target_population: patients with visual deficit regardless of cause
notes: used here as comparator for construct validity only; results in supplementary material (not in text)

domains: Mobility; Self-care; Usual activities; Pain/discomfort; Anxiety/depression; plus VAS 0-100
response_scale: 5 levels from no problem to extreme problems
